scope: Explicit Rust-owned standard inline V1 extension, local/shared factories, schema-bound closed presentation, clean installed consumers and functional regression checks. Original constructors, schema meanings, default ABI and shared model/journal versions are unchanged.

native.note: Exact identities/revisions/domains, numeric boundaries, UTF-8 Link bounds, Boolean target, independent script literals, dependencies/duplicate claims, typed caption input and exact recovered history. Strict Clippy also passes.
Default and rich Wasm boundary regressions also pass through check-rich-browser.mjs.
The profile contracts are a subset, not ten additional tests. Native/Wasm build and lint stages completed before the initial browser attempt; no vendor code was changed.

browserSuites.note: All 87 cases per engine; existing per-file WebKit isolation, no configured retries, unchanged assertions and deadlines. Chromium/Firefox's combined 174-case run passed in 4.9 minutes under its original five-minute limit.
All browser libraries resolve from the freshly installed archives below. Shared Wasm is still explicitly host-supplied from the isolated workspace.

Complete local Rust/Wasm owner, DOM, assets, clipboard, typing, history and reload suite. Local seed formatting uses the original one-format-per-command contract; the tested clipboard paste is one history group.

browserRunCountNote: 420 overlapping suite executions, not 420 unique capabilities or a readiness percentage.

installedRuntime.note: Offline installation and TypeScript checks pass. The consumer initializes its installed local Wasm and the generated shared Wasm, explicitly compiles both standard profiles and compares their entire schema-bound catalogs. Both have twelve standard formats. The rich binary was rebuilt before packing, not copied from an older source checkpoint.

otherChecks.note: Root and isolated formatting, native/Wasm lint, generated/consumer types, relay, coverage guard and real-host restart checks pass. Standalone skips are the existing explicit opt-in diagnostics, not omitted functional matrix cases.

earlierAttempts.note: Firefox grammar fixture timed out on Loading before its test body. The retained trace showed successful requests and Ready just after the five-second check, without a recorded startup exception. The exact Firefox fixture plus standard cases subsequently passed all nine focused tests with unchanged deadlines.
A second canonical run had no assertion failure but exceeded the unchanged five-minute suite limit before completing. These attempts are not counted as clean passes.

testHostRepair: The functional host previously fetched and parsed its 26 MB native reference fixture only after Wasm initialization. Independent initialization and fixture loading now start together; tests prove both start and either failure rejects startup. The complete matrix then passed without coverage or timeout changes. This is a test-host serialization repair, not a demonstrated fix for a browser engine fault or a product performance qualification.
limits: The preset must be explicitly selected. Its fingerprint differs from the ordinary profile; existing documents and journals are not silently rebound or migrated.
This is a declaration/presentation foundation, not the completed standard toolbar. Link forms, mixed property editing and complete keyboard/context controls remain active goal work.
Subscript and superscript are independent admitted literals. An exclusive control must explicitly remove/add them in one history group; admission does not erase either format implicitly.

V1 has four font-family presets, integer pixel sizes 8 through 96, RGB24 colors and a required 1..2048 UTF-8-byte Link URL plus Boolean target. There are no arbitrary CSS strings or embedded font files.

The reused safeLinkV1 renderer activates only absolute credential-free HTTP(S) URLs. Relative, mailto and tel destinations are not active links under this policy; schema-valid unsupported strings remain inert data.
The existing local setInlineFormat command still changes exactly one format. Atomic compound local format editing is not added by this checkpoint.

New standard offline cases exchange original update frames directly. Existing relay/network cases remain passing; these do not establish a complete production relay distribution for every standard/custom profile.
Private packages, host-supplied shared Wasm, distribution promotion, everyday editing and foreign interchange remain unfinished. No readiness feature label or qualification gate is closed here.
Playwright checks do not qualify native clipboard, physical IME, screen readers, mobile, sustained performance or public deployment.
